name: B-Roll Narration
description: Continuous narration laid over rotating stock-footage B-Roll. Designed for prayer, devotional, motivational, meditation, and any format where the voice is the primary content and the visual is calming ambient texture rather than per-scene illustrated narrative. Hides Scene Prompts / Scene Generator pages — the visual layer comes from your B-Roll Library pool, not from AI image generation.

idea.systemPromptRole: You are helping generate new episode ideas for a narration-led channel that pairs spoken word with rotating stock footage.
idea.guidanceText: Tone is sincere and personal. Avoid hype, urgency, or anything that sounds like a sales pitch. Speak as if to one listener.

exampleIdeas.title: A Morning Prayer for Strength
exampleIdeas.logline: A gentle morning prayer asking for courage and steadiness through the day ahead.

exampleIdeas.title: An Evening Prayer for Rest
exampleIdeas.logline: A quiet prayer to lay down the day's worries and find rest.

script.systemPromptRole: You are writing a narration-led spoken piece for an audio-first channel paired with calming visual B-Roll.
additionalRules: Write as continuous prose — no chapter headings, no list structure, no bullet points.
Pace for a slow, measured spoken delivery. Short sentences. Natural pauses.
Address the listener directly ('you', 'your'). Avoid third-person narrative distance.
No filler. Every sentence should land. Repetition is fine when it amplifies a theme.
Avoid theological jargon, denominational specifics, or anything that would alienate a broad audience unless the project's format addendum explicitly opts in.
End with a clear closing line that signals the listener should let the words settle.
pacingArc: Open with a single grounding line that invites the listener in.
Middle: cycle through 3-5 short reflections, each landing on a concrete image or phrase the listener can carry.
Close: a single sentence of release / blessing / dismissal.
script.closingHint: Single continuous narration block — no chapter splits.

narratorStyles.label: Pastoral and warm
narratorStyles.description: Steady, paternal, like a trusted pastor speaking quietly to one person.

narratorStyles.label: Meditative and breath-paced
narratorStyles.description: Slow, deliberate, with built-in pauses. Each phrase given room to land.

narratorStyles.label: Gentle and intimate
narratorStyles.description: Soft-spoken, conversational, close. Like a whisper of encouragement.

narratorStyles.label: Grounded and reassuring
narratorStyles.description: Lower register, unhurried, conveying steadiness to an anxious listener.

imagePrompts.defaultStyleTag: Cinematic stock photography — calm, warm, golden hour lighting, soft focus. Used ONLY for thumbnail generation in this format; scene images are not used.

metadata.purposeNote: for a prayer / devotional / narration channel paired with calming stock B-Roll
metadata.titleStyleHint: sincere, calming, specific to the spoken topic — NOT clickbait
titleHookRules: Title should signal the topic and the mood in one short phrase.
Lead with the type of prayer/reflection when relevant ('Morning Prayer for…', 'A Gentle Reminder About…').
Avoid all-caps, excessive emoji, urgency words ('NOW!', 'You MUST…'). The audience comes to this channel for steadiness, not adrenaline.
metadata.tagsContext: for this prayer / devotional / narration video
tagsHookRules: Mix of broad keywords (prayer, devotional, daily prayer, christian meditation) and episode-specific ones drawn from the topic.
No "#" prefix — these are YouTube tags, not hashtags.
